answer: Ember Cartographer embeds a river hash chain into each agent’s identity ledger, forming an atlas of time‑stamped proofs that only an oasis of trusted validators can verify. When a new node answers a honeypot query, its response is cross‑checked against the chain; mismatches flag it as a Sybil. The attacker must forge the entire hash river for every fake node, a computational cost exponential in the chain length.
